newsitem.title: USA: Shell shuts Alabama refinery ahead of hurricane.
newsitem.headline: Shell shuts Alabama refinery ahead of hurricane.

text.p: Shell Oil Co said it shut its 74,000 barrel-per-day refinery in Saraland, Alabamo Friday ahead of the expected arrival of Hurricane Danny early Saturday.

"It's cooling down right now," said Noel Wheeler, external affairs manager with Shell Chemical. "If we don't have any interruption in power we maybe could start it back up tomorrow evening," he added.
The refinery takes about five to eight hours to restart, he said.

The center of the hurricane was located near latitude 29.9 north and longitude 88.8 west, or about 65 miles (100 km) south-southwest of Mobile, Alabama. Danny is moving slowly toward the northeast at 6 mph (9 km) an hour.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
